android_mechanism: Network resource (socket/stream) not released after use; fix closes/releases it
bug_description: getWeatherUtil.getWeather creates a new http.createHttp() session for every weather request, retains the session and the full response body in the viewmodel, and never calls request.destroy(). Each city refresh leaks an HTTP session plus its complete response for the lifetime of the app, so repeated refreshes and multi-city loads accumulate retained memory.
fix_summary: Sessions are no longer retained after creation, and each request session is destroyed in a finally handler after the response/error callback completes.

test_oracle.definition: bytes still allocated at step end (malloc/free matching) from the nativehook plugin stream in trace.htrace.
test_oracle.comparison: unfixed >= 1.2 * fixed over >= 3 rounds per variant

evidence.measured_as: VmRSS delta over 120 weather requests (Pura 70 Ultra)
evidence.note: +57.0MB vs +38.5MB VmRSS growth over the same 120-request workload (~18MB = 120 retained response bodies; disjoint ranges, 1.48x). fd counts are flat in both variants because sessions pool sockets, so the oracle is retained bytes (measurements-staging-v2).

mechanism_oracle.definition: Growth of the app process fd count and ESTABLISHED/TIME_WAIT socket count attributable to weather requests after N refreshes.
mechanism_oracle.comparison: unfixed retains roughly one session (fd) per request after requests complete; fixed returns to baseline. unfixed_fd_growth > fixed_fd_growth by >= 5x over 30 requests.

reproduction: git -C hosts/weatherassistant checkout case/weatherassistant_http_session_leak/unfixed; apply the measurement harness patch for this case, build, sign and install the HAP.
git -C hosts/weatherassistant checkout case/weatherassistant_http_session_leak/fixed; rebuild, reinstall and repeat identically.
Compare test_oracle.metric across the two report sets: unfixed >= 1.2 * fixed.
